title: Mexican Stuffed Peppers
subtitle: Roasted bell peppers filled with pinto beans, brown rice and tomatoes, baked under melted cheese.
protein: ~13–15g protein per adult serving — from beans, rice and cheese

method.title: Roast the peppers and cook the rice
items: Preheat the oven to 425°F; halve {@peppers} from stem to base, removing the seeds and membranes
Place them in a 9×13-inch dish or a lined sheet; drizzle with {@olive-oil:roast} and sprinkle with {@salt:roast}
Rub the oil over both sides; arrange cut side up and sprinkle {@pepper} on all but one half — that one is the toddler's
Bake 20–25 min, until blistered at the edges and fork-tender; set aside and leave the oven on
Meanwhile bring a large pot of water to a boil; rinse {@rice} until the water runs clear
Boil the rice uncovered 30 min (lower the heat if it froths), then drain and return to the pot

method.title: Make the filling
items: Warm {@olive-oil:filling} in a large skillet over medium heat until shimmering; add {@hing}
Add {@celery} and {@salt:filling}; cook, stirring often, until tender, about 5 min
Add {@tomatoes}; cook until lightly squishy, another 5 min
Take the pan off the heat; add {@rice|the cooked rice}, {@beans} and {@lime}; stir and adjust with {@salt:adjust}

method.label: Toddler — fill her pepper here (before chili)
items: Spoon {=½ cup} of filling into her unpeppered half, lightly mashing the beans

method.title: Spice, stuff and bake
items: Return the skillet to low; stir in {@chili} and {@oregano} for 1 min
Pour off any juice pooled in the peppers, then stuff each one generously
Top every half, hers included, with {@cheese}
Bake at 425°F for 12–13 min, until the cheese is golden in spots
Serve warm with {@cilantro:garnish} and {@garnish}; leftovers keep 4 days covered in the fridge

method.label: Tip
method.text: Onion → celery + hing; garlic → more hing. US chili powder blends usually aren't Jain, so Kashmiri chili + oregano stand in. Store salsa isn't Jain either — top with avocado or sour cream. Make ahead: cook the rice and roast the peppers early, or stuff completely and refrigerate, adding a few minutes to the bake. Leftover filling is a good side dish. Best in the oven, which roasts all 8 halves at once; the Instant Pot can cook the brown rice (22 min high pressure) while the peppers roast.
